title: MPOS | How to Accept Customer Payments
description:
This tutorial explains how to collect and record customer payments using the MPOS Rider App.

You will learn how to access the payment screen, select the appropriate payment method, confirm the transaction, and ensure that payments are successfully recorded against the order

Download the App - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.quickdrycleaning.qdcpos
